name: sprint12_taker_imbalance_btc_eth
hypothesis: Short-horizon taker buy/sell volume imbalance in BTCUSD/ETHUSD order flow predicts a net-positive short-hold return, exploitable after realistic T1 costs.
power_argument: 1-min bars, BTCUSD+ETHUSD, ~20 trading days, imbalance threshold loosened vs sprint10 (which yielded n=0) to target 15-20 qualifying entries/symbol/day -> expected >=300+ trades in-window. Powered to detect a minimum net edge of ~5bps at conventional significance given T1 fees + spread; if n<300 again the run itself is diagnostic evidence of a feed/threshold defect, not a null result.
